pr.title: 424242 - Usage quota module reads requestsPerMinute
pr.author: sam-dev
pr.body:
This pull request updates the usage quota module to read requestsPerMinute and to write monthlyBudget and usagePlanTier into the usage record the gateway reads.

It also retires the old shared master key.

reviewComments.author: Copilot
reviewComments.body: The master subscription cannot be deleted while products still reference it, so this apply will fail on first run.

reviewComments.author: Copilot
reviewComments.body: Add a validation block so requestsPerMinute must be a positive whole number.

issueComments.author: lee-reviewer
issueComments.body: Needs the config PR to go in at the same time.

commits.message: Write budget and tier into the usage record
